title: Representations of solutions to Stein equations and their derivatives
summary: We propose pointwise representations of the Stein solution to a weighted first-order Stein equation associated with a univariate absolutely continuous distribution. The representation extends to all the derivatives of the solution and with respect to any derivative of the test function. The mechanism behind these representations is an array of kernels that satisfy two key identities, yielding a specific calculus for the Stein framework considered here.
